name: Soketi
description: Soketi is your simple, fast, and resilient open-source WebSockets server.
composeYaml:
services:
  soketi:
    image: 'quay.io/soketi/soketi:1.6-16-debian'
    environment:
      - 'SOKETI_DEBUG=${DEBUG:-0}'
      - 'SOKETI_DEFAULT_APP_ID=${SOKETI_USER}'
      - 'SOKETI_DEFAULT_APP_KEY=${SOKETIKEY}'
      - 'SOKETI_DEFAULT_APP_SECRET=${SOKETISECRET}'
      - 'SOKETI_PUSHER_SCHEME=${SOKETI_PUSHER_SCHEME:-https}'
      - 'SOKETI_DEFAULT_APP_ENABLE_CLIENT_MESSAGES=${DEFAULT_APP_ENABLE_CLIENT_MESSAGES}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - "bash -c ':> /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/6001' || exit 1"
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 3
